name: analysing a requirement
from: A requirement in whatever words the raiser used, which nothing can grade. Nobody can say whether it has been met, so whoever built something against it will say, and be believed.
to: A requirement carrying conditions a machine settles, and a tier naming which body decides it. Anyone can now say whether it has been met, and the raiser does not have to be in the room to find out.
cost: The analysis body's attention, spent up front and spent whether or not the requirement is ever taken up — including on requirements that get refused, which is most of the cost and all of the value.
